title: Integrability of a compactly supported continuous function times a function continuous on (a, b)
statement: Let a, b be reals and κ, χ : ℝ → ℝ. Suppose κ is continuous on the open interval (a, b), χ is continuous on ℝ, χ has compact support, and tsupport χ ⊆ (a, b). Then the function x ↦ χ(x)·κ(x) is Lebesgue integrable on ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (κ χ : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn κ (Ioo a b) → Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → tsupport χ ⊆ Ioo a b → Integrable (fun x => χ x * κ x)
